hard_numeric_fact_text: Management states YTD FY27 order inflow ~Rs20,000 cr vs FY26 revenue Rs27,143 cr (0.74x), >30% YoY; UAE gas pipeline LoA classed Major (>Rs4,000 cr). Filed press releases (MANAGEMENT CLAIM). Latest single announcement is Rs2,225 cr (8% of revenue), not Rs20,000 cr as the dossier event row shows.
thesis: T&D/EPC order momentum (YTD ~Rs20,000 cr claimed, L1 on >Rs12,000 cr more, UAE gas pipeline LoA) at 21.5x TTM P/E with healthy FY CFO/PAT 1.48 and ND/EBITDA 0.77. But latest quarter revenue was -9.3% YoY with EBITDA +4.5%; PAT +37.5% is helped by one-offs (13.7% of EBITDA). Orders have not yet converted to revenue/margin; margin ~8.8% is thin EPC. Valuation is reasonable but not an obvious asymmetry. Needs reported revenue acceleration.
chain_missing_links: Order to revenue conversion (Q1 FY27 revenue -9.3% YoY)
Operating leverage (EBITDA margin 8.8%, one-offs 13.7% of EBITDA)
Order book size and execution period unknown
demand_signal: Management: T&D grid/renewable-integration capex; sector peers (KEC) also report strong inflows (MANAGEMENT CLAIM). Peer median revenue growth -5.6% in dossier scan.
supply_signal: unknown; EPC is competitive, no shortage evidence in filings
order_book: unknown total; YTD inflow ~Rs20,000 cr and L1 >Rs12,000 cr (MANAGEMENT CLAIM). Dossier order_intensity 0.49 is mislabelled: it treats the cumulative YTD figure as one order. Real latest announcement Rs2,225 cr incl. SEK200m (~Rs194 cr) Linjemontage order.
debt: ND/EBITDA 0.77; interest cover 6.8; rating upgrade 2026-07-03 (FACT, filing text not extracted)
valuation: TTM P/E 21.5, EV/EBITDA 11.0, PEG 0.61 (CALCULATION). Implied EPS ~Rs65.

plausible.2x: NO: needs ~Rs130 EPS at 21x in 2y, i.e. ~2x EPS on ~10% margins

kill_conditions: Two consecutive quarters of YoY revenue decline despite order claims
CFO/PAT below 0.7 or receivable days rising above 130
Material order cancellation or bank-guarantee/legal issue
catalysts: Q2 FY27 results (Nov 2026): revenue growth and margin
Conversion of L1 >Rs12,000 cr to orders
Analyst meet 30 Sep 2026 commentary (text not extracted)
biggest_risk: Orders do not convert into profitable revenue; EPC margins stay ~8-9% and PAT growth was one-off aided
